risks.risk: High shutter count indicating the camera is near the end of its mechanical life.
risks.proof: A screenshot from a shutter count utility (e.g., EOSInfo) showing the total actuations.
risks.if_unproven: as having a very high shutter count/near end of life.

risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the sensor with the mirror locked up, or a test shot of a white wall at f/22.
risks.if_unproven: as having a damaged sensor requiring replacement.

risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, the LCD screen working, and the menu being navigated.

risks.risk: Missing essential accessories like battery and charger.
risks.proof: A photo showing the battery and the specific charger for this model.
risks.if_unproven: as body only, without battery or charger.

proof_requests: A screenshot of the shutter count.
A video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
A photo of the image sensor with the body cap removed.
Photos of the battery and charger if included.
response.reason: The witness has clearly identified the specific model and brand, allowing for a valuation based on its worst-case functional condition.
